core_statement: For independent three-bank reflection variables with scalar density caps <=K, arbitrary positive mixtures of conditioning-generated affine fields of mass m have output density cap <=6 sqrt(pi) K^2 m. For product-preserving disjoint banks A=[[U^T B_* U,U^T C],[C^T U,D]], the newest physical reflection Schur-boundary dichotomy transfers after cap scaling: R=D-C^T B_*C nonzero gives majority-sheet cap pi sqrt(2) K^2 (mass-linear under outside positive localization), while R=0 requires full-law sheet cancellation and retains the mass-linear 6 sqrt(pi) K^2 bound.

partner_applied.use: Transferred exact Schur invariant R=D-C^T B_* C to disjoint product-bank variables after uniform cap scaling; preserved atomless-boundary majority regularity in R!=0 and full-law sheet cancellation in R=0.

source_valid_obstruction: For flat even banks A_m=U^T B_*U has nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; every invertible physical triple is B_*/m so Theorem A gives 6 sqrt(pi)m, and Theorem B gives 6 sqrt(2pi)sqrt(m), while Theorem F gives the unchanged whole law <=12. Thus physical reciprocal localization and fibre summation can diverge on a uniformly controlled exact-target family.
remaining_gap: A general matrix with s3(A)>=1 need not have the factor-through-bank form. One must extract a product-preserving nondegenerate bank core while retaining arbitrary same-bank quadratic curvature and orthogonal cross leakage, or force a previously paid whole-law exit. Small matrix coefficients cannot be discarded for unbounded rough inputs.
